shortDescription: Write, read, and verify opaque artifacts in IdM vaults

options.name: description
options.description: Optional vault description when creating the vault.

options.name: expected_sha256
options.description: Expected artifact SHA-256 digest.

options.name: include_metadata
options.description: Include vault metadata in the result.

options.name: include_payload
options.description: Include retrieved payload in C(artifact_payload) for C(state=read). Use task-level C(no_log: true) when enabling this option.

options.name: ipaadmin_password
options.description: Password for the principal.

options.name: ipaadmin_principal
options.description: Kerberos principal to authenticate as.

options.name: kerberos_keytab
options.description: Path to a Kerberos keytab file.

options.name: name
options.description: Vault/artifact name.

options.name: payload
options.description: Artifact payload to archive.

options.name: payload_encoding
options.description: Encoding used when returning C(artifact_payload).

options.name: payload_file
options.description: File containing the artifact payload to archive.

options.name: private_key_file
options.description: Private key file for asymmetric vault reads.

options.name: read_back
options.description: Read the artifact after writing and verify the digest.

options.name: server
options.description: FQDN of the IPA server.

options.name: service
options.description: Service vault scope.

options.name: shared
options.description: Shared vault scope.

options.name: state
options.description: C(present), C(archived), and C(write) archive C(payload) into the vault. C(read) retrieves the artifact digest and optional payload. C(absent) removes the vault.

options.name: username
options.description: User vault scope.

options.name: vault_password
options.description: Password for symmetric vault operations.

options.name: vault_password_file
options.description: File containing the symmetric vault password.

options.name: vault_type
options.description: Vault type to use when creating the vault.

options.name: verify
options.description: Path to the IPA CA certificate for TLS verification.
